evidence: Implements BIP 54 soft fork consensus validation logic across src/consensus/ and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: This PR implements the consensus validation rules for BIP 54 to resolve longstanding vulnerabilities including CVE-2017-12842 Merkle tree collisions and timewarp attacks. Because it is scoped to regtest without mainnet activation, delay is not an immediate mainnet hazard, but completing and testing the consensus implementation is strategically important for soft fork readiness.
